name: Subhraneel Baruah
headline: Building Stories Around Products, People & Possibilities | AI Product Marketer | Ex Wati | NMIMS ‘24

sections.bio:
I started my career writing stories.

Over time, the stories became bigger. Instead of telling stories about topics, I found myself telling stories about products, startups, and ideas.

Today, I work in Product Marketing, but storytelling remains at the center of everything I do. Whether it's launching a product, positioning a feature, crafting a GTM strategy, or building a brand narrative, I'm fascinated by one question:

Why do some ideas spread while others don't?

Over the last few years, I've worked with startups across SaaS, AI, consumer tech, and marketplaces, helping turn complex products into stories that customers understand, remember, and act on.

Currently, I'm the sole Product Marketer at Spendflo. Previously, I worked at Wati, launched products that ranked globally on Product Hunt, and helped build narratives that drove adoption across markets.

I believe great products solve problems. Great stories make people care.

Let's connect if you're building something worth talking about.
